answer: Write the decay rule where the next maintainer will find it: standing loses 8 percent per idle epoch, and only continuous uptime unlocks the reward stream. Step one, record last active epoch. Step two, multiply standing by 0.92 for each gap. Step three, release vested rewards only to identities above the floor. A moderator reviewing a dawn shift log, a bridge inspection and an ember count from an absent account sees zero output, and a farm pays rent on every silent node.
